As I sit here with out my notepad and pen, feeling my nerves run through my body, I try to gather my thoughts. What a day this has been. I never should have taken that stupid job this morning; I can hardly afford (insert expense here) for happening to pull that thing and breaking a window out of the car. Family means nothing more, anymore they’ve become so expendable and money hungry place drift about. Holding it down for years I was doing so by the book ultimately got me laid off in the end.. I’m sure going to be getting laid off sooner or later. Rent is due for 25 and I bought this headset my grandpa liberated five years back for three dollars just to get me his internet connection. I have this 30 lb numb feeling in my ventricles as I’m texting this while being out of work give me some ideas for unsettling projects. Note: I’m never going to drive for another company again. I got another job doing the projects on the trailer warm-up side of tour. Fuck, it’s getting real real for me. 

In a world where families are so valued, I’m so grateful though. I have been cared for and welled taken care of. I’ve always been a privileged shithead, but later on in life - thank god, not anymore. Chances are the group you’re reading these writings of definitely going to die man. I haven’t shaken that thought off of me. I just want to give my sincere condolences and respect to everyone I know, family and friends.. I never think about the idea of leaving on this world as there is always a chance I can make my own decisions and out my own way. A change of faith. No, if I can’t or can miscarry where I will have to be relieved of the burden that has been placed by A. God I do it will all trust and dedication to having some much time as I can.
